formal_statement: ∃ (b s₀ n₀ : ℕ), 0 < s₀ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∃ G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph (n + 1) n, PEqualNP.Expanders.LeftDegLe G b ∧ PEqualNP.Expanders.RightDegLe G b ∧ PEqualNP.Expanders.IsBdryExpander G (n / s₀) 2
plain_statement: For some degree bound b and constant s0, every large n has a bipartite graph with n+1 left and n right vertices, all degrees at most b, in which every left set of at most n/s0 vertices has at least twice its size in unique neighbours. By counting: random left-regular graphs built from b permutations, union bound over small sets (standard, for example the lossless expander estimates in Hoory, Linial and Wigderson, Bull. AMS 43, 2006). Link (a) of the L-pcx-017 chain.
title: Bounded-degree bipartite boundary expanders exist (n+1 pigeons, n holes)
